Mattermost.definition: Brand name of the product and the company; never translate or transliterate.

Enterprise Edition.definition: Name of the commercial, licensed edition of the Mattermost server.

Team Edition.definition: Name of the free, open-source edition of the Mattermost server.

Mattermost Cloud.definition: Name of the hosted SaaS offering of Mattermost.

Channels.definition: Product name of the Mattermost messaging product; as a product name it stays in English, unlike the common noun 'channel'.

Playbooks.definition: Product name of the Mattermost workflow product; as a product name it stays in English.

Boards.definition: Product name of the Mattermost project/kanban board product; as a product name it stays in English.

Calls.definition: Product name of the Mattermost voice/video calling feature; as a product name it stays in English.

Markdown.definition: Name of the text formatting syntax used in Mattermost messages.

OAuth.definition: Authorization protocol used for app integrations and single sign-on; technical identity.

SAML.definition: Single sign-on protocol (Security Assertion Markup Language); technical identity.

LDAP.definition: Directory protocol used for AD/LDAP login and user sync; technical identity.

SSO.definition: Abbreviation for single sign-on; keep the abbreviation as-is.

MFA.definition: Abbreviation for multi-factor authentication; keep the abbreviation as-is.

OpenID Connect.definition: Identity protocol used as a single sign-on option; technical identity.

Entra ID.definition: Microsoft's identity platform (formerly Azure AD), offered as a login option.

GitLab.definition: Third-party product offered as a single sign-on option; brand name.

Elasticsearch.definition: Third-party search engine that can back Mattermost's search; brand name.

Bleve.definition: Name of the embedded search engine option in the System Console; brand name.

Gossip.definition: Name of the cluster communication protocol shown in high-availability settings; never translate literally as 'chatter'.

Actiance XML.definition: Name of a compliance export format; product identity.

Global Relay.definition: Third-party compliance archiving service and export format; brand name.

System Console.definition: The administrator interface where system admins configure the Mattermost server; translate consistently as a named UI area.

marketplace.definition: The in-product store where admins browse and install plugins and apps.

channel.definition: A conversation space where messages are exchanged; the basic organizing unit of communication in Mattermost.

team.definition: A named collection of channels and users; a workspace can contain multiple teams.

post.definition: A single message published to a channel or thread; used interchangeably with 'message' in the UI.

message.definition: Text (and attachments) a user sends in a channel, thread, or direct message.

thread.definition: A set of replies attached to a root message, viewed and followed as one conversation.

reply.definition: A message posted in a thread in response to a root message; also the act of doing so.

direct message.definition: A private one-to-one conversation between two users.

group message.definition: A private conversation among three to eight users, without a named channel.

mention.definition: Referencing a user or group with @username so they are notified; also the notification itself.

notification.definition: An alert (desktop, email, or mobile) informing a user of activity such as mentions or replies.

pin.definition: To attach a message to a channel's pinned list so all members can find it easily.

bookmark.definition: A saved link or file attached to the top of a channel for quick access; also the act of adding one.

saved messages.definition: A user's personal list of messages they saved for later follow-up; visible only to that user.

draft.definition: An unsent message that is kept until the user sends, schedules, or deletes it.

scheduled post.definition: A message set to be sent automatically at a future date and time.

emoji.definition: A small pictograph inserted into messages or used as a reaction.

custom emoji.definition: A user-uploaded emoji available across the workspace in addition to the standard set.

reaction.definition: An emoji attached to an existing message to respond without posting a reply.

status.definition: A user's availability indicator: online, away, do not disturb, or offline.

custom status.definition: A user-defined emoji and text (e.g. 'In a meeting') shown next to their name, separate from availability.

do not disturb.definition: Availability status that silences all notifications until turned off or a timer expires.

away.definition: Availability status shown when a user is inactive or sets themselves as away.

online.definition: Availability status shown when a user is active in Mattermost.

offline.definition: Availability status shown when a user is not connected to Mattermost.

out of office.definition: Availability status set automatically or manually when a user is away from work; can trigger automatic replies.

guest.definition: An account type with restricted access, limited to specific channels and teams they are invited to.

member.definition: A regular (non-guest, non-admin) user belonging to a team or channel.

user.definition: Any account on the Mattermost server, including members, guests, admins, and bots.

system admin.definition: The highest administrative role, with full access to the System Console and server settings.

team admin.definition: A role with administrative permissions scoped to a single team.

channel admin.definition: A role with administrative permissions scoped to a single channel.

session.definition: An authenticated login on a device; sessions expire and can be revoked by admins.

sign in.definition: To authenticate and start a session; the UI uses 'log in' and 'sign in' interchangeably — translate both the same way.

sign out.definition: To end the current session; the UI uses 'log out' and 'sign out' interchangeably — translate both the same way.

join.definition: To become a member of a channel or team.

leave.definition: To remove oneself from a channel or team.

archive.definition: To close a channel so it becomes read-only and hidden from the sidebar, without deleting its history.

unarchive.definition: To restore an archived channel to active use.

mute.definition: To silence notifications from a channel while remaining a member; distinct from muting a microphone in Calls.

follow.definition: To subscribe to a thread (or message) so its replies appear in the Threads view and trigger notifications.

unfollow.definition: To stop following a thread and its reply notifications.

favorite.definition: To mark a channel so it appears in the Favorites sidebar category; also the marked item itself.

search.definition: The feature for finding messages and files across channels using terms and modifiers.

integration.definition: A connection between Mattermost and an external tool, such as webhooks, slash commands, or OAuth apps.

slash command.definition: A command typed in the message box starting with '/', which triggers a built-in or custom action.

webhook.definition: An HTTP-based integration for posting or receiving messages; the word may be translated or kept depending on locale convention, but must be consistent.

incoming webhook.definition: An integration that lets external services post messages into a Mattermost channel.

outgoing webhook.definition: An integration that sends channel messages matching trigger words to an external service.

trigger word.definition: A word that, when it starts or appears in a message, activates an outgoing webhook.

plugin.definition: An installable extension that adds features to the Mattermost server and apps.

bot.definition: A non-human account used by integrations and plugins to post and interact.

role.definition: A named set of permissions assigned to users, such as member, team admin, or system admin.

permission.definition: An individual capability (e.g. create channels) that roles grant or deny.

scheme.definition: A named set of role-to-permission mappings applied to teams or channels (permission scheme).

license.definition: The file or key that activates paid Mattermost features on a server.

seat.definition: One licensed user slot counted against a paid subscription.

trial.definition: A time-limited free period of Enterprise features before purchasing a license.

workspace.definition: A complete Mattermost instance (server plus its teams and data), especially in Cloud contexts.

subscription.definition: A recurring paid plan for Mattermost Cloud or licensed features.

deactivate.definition: To disable a user account so it can no longer sign in, without deleting its data.

invite.definition: To ask a person to join a team or channel, typically by email or link; also the request itself.

invitation.definition: The email or link sent when inviting someone to a team or channel.

sidebar.definition: The left-hand panel listing channels, direct messages, and categories.

unread.definition: Describes messages or channels with content the user has not viewed yet.

attachment.definition: A file or media item included with a message.

public channel.definition: A channel any team member can find and join.

private channel.definition: A channel visible only to invited members.

shared channel.definition: A channel shared across connected Mattermost workspaces so users on different servers can participate.

channel header.definition: The editable text shown at the top of a channel, next to the channel name.

channel purpose.definition: A short description of what a channel is for, shown in channel info and search.

system message.definition: An automatic message posted by Mattermost itself, e.g. when someone joins or renames a channel.

persistent notification.definition: A repeated notification for an urgent message that keeps alerting recipients until acknowledged.

message priority.definition: A label (Standard, Important, Urgent) a sender can attach to a message to indicate importance.

urgent.definition: The highest message priority level; shown as a red label on the message.

recap.definition: An AI-generated summary of activity in one or more channels over a time period.

agent.definition: An AI assistant in Mattermost that users can ask questions or delegate tasks to.

burn-on-read.definition: A message type that is permanently deleted a set time after the recipient reads it.

magic link.definition: A sign-in link sent by email that authenticates the user without a password.

personal access token.definition: A user-generated credential for authenticating API requests without a password.

announcement banner.definition: A system-wide banner configured by admins, shown across the top of the app for all users.

channel banner.definition: A colored banner with custom text shown at the top of a specific channel.

keyword.definition: A word or phrase a user configures to trigger mention notifications when posted.

user group.definition: A named collection of users that can be @-mentioned together and used for membership management.

permalink.definition: A permanent link to a specific message that can be copied and shared.

profile.definition: A user's account information: name, username, nickname, picture, and custom attributes.

username.definition: The unique handle used for @-mentions and sign-in; distinct from the display name.

nickname.definition: An optional informal name a user can set, shown according to display settings.

display name.definition: The human-readable name shown for a user, channel, team, or server in the UI.

collapsed reply threads.definition: The threading mode where replies are grouped under the root message and tracked in a Threads view.

auto-translation.definition: A feature that automatically translates channel messages into the viewer's language.

data retention.definition: Admin policies that automatically delete messages and files after a set period.

compliance export.definition: An admin feature that exports message history in formats required for legal compliance.

access control.definition: Attribute-based rules that restrict who can access certain channels or resources.

attribute.definition: A custom profile field or property (e.g. department) used on user profiles and in access control rules.

onboarding.definition: The guided first-run experience that helps new users and admins set up Mattermost.

Town Square.definition: The default channel every team member belongs to; translate as a channel name, consistently.

Off-Topic.definition: A default channel for informal conversation created with each team; translate consistently.

read-only.definition: Describes a channel where only authorized users can post; others can only read.

server.definition: The Mattermost backend instance that hosts teams, channels, and users.
